verdict.rationale: Mesh is API-first and can run entirely without the web UI. Programmatic API credentials come with scoped permissions and optional expiry. Screening runs synchronously, asynchronously or through a Batch Processing API, results arrive by WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks, and cases, alerts and risks can be remediated via the API instead of the web app. A downloadable OpenAPI schema and Postman collection support scripted integration. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific guidance (e.g., non-interactive pipeline examples), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an authenticated headless run (the probe only retrieved documentation).
